info.name: SCM - Commission, User, Dealer & Plan APIs
info.description:
Postman collection generated from the Sales Channel Management (SCM) React app.

Covers 4 modules:
1. Commission Configuration (Prepaid FRC/OTF, Postpaid, Landline, Modification, Franchise Add Balance)
2. User Management (User Creation, Search/Edit, Permissions, Status, Password, Logout)
3. Dealer Management (Dealer & Franchise Creation, Search/Edit, Status, Hierarchy, MPIN Reset)
4. Plan & Number Configuration (Plans, Denomination, MNP, Number Series)

Flow note: Most write operations require a two-step OTP flow — call **Send OTP** (with a topic) then **Validate OTP** before the actual mutation. Response bodies use `{ status, message, data }` with a `status` field in the JSON body.

Edit the collection variables (in the Variables tab) to set your session values.
